name: Ootori Yuka
source:
Yuka is only interested in beautiful or interesting things and people.
Since her sensibility is completely different from ordinary people, other students are being swayed by her. She is particularly fond of [url=/c11298]Haruka[/url].
Also, Yuka has a surprising side - she is a model.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=559385]Getchu[/url].]
